correctness.rationale: A rook-selected set corresponds to an edge subset H of K_(m,n). Induced connectedness is exactly nonempty edge-support connectedness, domination iff at least one shore is fully occupied. A minimal support has no cycle and cannot occupy both whole shores; no occupied leaf is permitted on the nonsaturated shore. Weighted bipartite spanning-tree identity counts r selected rows or columns with degree >=2 via r!S(n-1,r)*n^(r-1); summing both shores yields exactly the stated polynomial and union of two size intervals, with gap n-2m+1 for 2<=m<=n with n>=2m. Independent exhaustive rook masks (2,3),(3,3),(3,4) matched Stirling families, including (3,4) coefficients 4z^3+39z^4+72z^5. Infinite reasoning rests on tree argument, not finite check.
